items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I got a lot of people in the band from time to time... I got Paul Campbell. Is he also known as Soup Campbell? Soupy, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, I got a lot of people in the band from time to time: Bernie Peacock, Ernie, Jimmy. [Let’s] see. Who else? I got Paul Campbell.
Is he also known as Soup Campbell?
